spins.label: Eighteenth Street Lounge Music
spins.publish_note: Thievery Corporation is an American electronic music duo consisting of Rob Garza and Eric Hilton. Their musical style mixes elements of dub, acid jazz, reggae, Indian classical, Middle Eastern music, hip hop, electronica, and Brazilian music, including bossa nova. History Thievery Corporation was formed in the summer of 1995 at Washington D.C.'s Eighteenth Street Lounge.[1] Rob Garza and Lounge co-owner Eric Hilton were drawn together over their mutual love of club life, as well as dub, bossa nova, reggae, EDM, and jazz records. They decided to see what would come of mixing all these in a recording studio, and from this, in 1996 the duo started their Eighteenth Street Lounge Music record label.

spins.label: Global Dragon/Desert Trax
spins.publish_note: Desert Dwellers, founded in 1999 by Amani Friend and Treavor Moontribe from the legendary Moontribe gatherings, is a pioneering electronic project fusing deep bass, world instruments, and psychedelic textures Desert Dwellers consists of Amani Friend and Treavor Moontribe, who began their careers as independent music producers and DJs in the deserts of New Mexico and California. Coming together in the late '90s after connecting through the legendary Moontribe scene, today the duo enjoys a reputation as one of the most pioneering and prolific downtempo, psy-bass, and tribal trance acts in the United States. A fusion of folklore and future sound, Symbolico’s remix of “Dreams Within A Dream” dives into the subconscious realms of Desert Dwellers’ iconic Breath album, emerging with a jewel of psychedelic bass alchemy. Honoring the original’s Spanish lullaby, vocals by Meagan Chandler, flamenco guitar by Joaquin Gallegos, santur by Afshin Sadeghi, and flute by Lynda Arnold, Symbolico weaves his playful and soulful signature through the track’s hypnotic roots.

spins.label: Beats Antique Records
spins.publish_note: Longstanding friends from the Los Angeles-based duo Bósa and Bay Area world fusion trio Beats Antique have teamed up to deliver a hypnotic expedition in “Ouroboros,” now out via the latter’s Beats Antique Records banner. Growing like wildfire under the canopy of live electronica and world roots music comes a masterful merge of modern technology, live instrumentation and seductive performance, built of brass bands and glitch, string quartets and dubstep: the musical trio Beats Antique. The ouroboros is an ancient symbol of a serpent eating its own tail. A cycle of life, death, and rebirth.

spins.label: Burger Records / The Reverberation Appreciation Society
spins.publish_note: Elephant Stone is a Canadian indie rock band. Fronted by Rishi Dhir, the band incorporates aspects of traditional Indian music including the sitar, tabla, and dilruba with Western psychedelic rock. Dhir formed Elephant Stone in 2009 after he left The High Dials. The band combined Indian classical music and instrumentation with 1960s pop and rock.

spins.publish_note: In 2012, a striking new voice emerged from the wider surge of electronic music in the U.S. In an age of manufactured internet buzz and carefully plotted hype, ODESZA’s story was refreshingly authentic: A brilliant new duo unveiled their music on the internet, and the world paid attention. Odesza (/oʊˈdɛzə/; stylized in all caps)[7] is an American electronic music duo originating from Bellingham, Washington. It consists of Harrison Mills and Clayton Knight, known individually as Catacombkid and BeachesBeaches. They formed in 2012, shortly before Mills and Knight graduated from Western Washington University. Alexandra Cheatle (born 6 June 1994), known by her stage name Zyra, is an English singer, songwriter and record producer.

spins.label: Metal Blade Records
spins.publish_note: American instrumental post-rock band from Akron, Ohio. They self-released their self-titled debut EP in 2006. Independent record label the Mylene Sheath re-issued the EP on vinyl in 2007 and went on to publish the band's debut studio album, Above the Earth, Below the Sky, on vinyl also, in 2009. The band self-released their second album, Red Forest, in March 2012, with a vinyl version coming out through Science of Silence Records. They followed it with a self-promoted tour throughout Europe in April 2012.[4] If These Trees Could Talk issued their third album, The Bones of a Dying World, in June 2016, on Metal Blade Records. All their previous releases were subsequently re-issued in 2021 and 2022 on the same label. In February 2024, they published the single "Trail of Whispering Giants", their first new material in nearly eight years.

spins.label: Defrostatica
spins.publish_note: German Jungle/D&B producer Daniel Schwerdel. Released music (since 2008) on labels like: Metalheadz, Paradox Music, Renegade Hardware, AGN7 Audio, Tuff Love Dubs, CIA Records, Force Recordings, Dispatch, Rupture London, Lossless Music, Repertoire etc. Acid Lab lands on Defrostatica with two deep cuts. On Listen he places echoing chords across a grainy stereo field, supported by steady half-tempo kicks at 170 bpm. Lights Down Low continues the moody vibe, albeit with a sparse post-dubstep era beat and haunting voices at 150 bpm. The prolific producer from South-Germany, who prefers not to DJ but to concentrate on making music for over 15 years, has releases and co-productions on renowned labels such as Metalheadz, Repertoire, Alphacut and others.

spins.label: Naked Music Recordings
spins.publish_note: Musician, producer and remixer Jay Denes, better known as Blue Six, was born in Newark, NJ. After moving to N.Y.C., the newcomer failed to get seriously involved in the local music scene until hip-hop producer Bob Power hooked him up with Dave Boonshoff. Jay Denes began working on his own freestyle project soon after naming himself Blue Six. Released by Naked Music, his debut full-length record called Beautiful Tomorrow delivered a mix of electronic music, soulful pop, and smooth jazz, featuring contributions from multi-instrumentalist Marc Anthony Jones.

spins.label: Futurerecordings
spins.publish_note: Instrumental post-rock band hailing from Columbus, Ohio, known for their cinematic soundscapes and emotive compositions. Formed in 2009, the group consists of Kevin Shannon (guitar), Trish Chisholm (guitar), Wes Jackson (bass), Bryan West (drums), and Tara Mayer (keys). Their music is characterized by expansive, atmospheric arrangements that weave together elements of post-rock and cinematic soundscapes, drawing comparisons to bands like Explosions in the Sky and Caspian. Notable releases include their LP Pacific-Atlantic and the EP In Excelsis, which have cemented their reputation within the genre. "Pacific·Atlantic" is an album by The End of The Ocean, released on March 1, 2011, showcasing a blend of post-rock and instrumental music with captivating melodies and dynamic arrangements.

spins.publish_note: The Fauns are a British rock band that formed in 2007 in Bristol, England. The band consists of Alison Garner (vocals), Will Slater (guitar), Michael Savage (bass) and Guy Rhys-Davies (drums).

spins.label: Sub Pop
spins.publish_note: Still Corners are a British/American dream pop band formed in 2007 consisting of songwriter/producer Greg Hughes and vocalist Tessa Murray. Hughes self-released the debut EP under the Still Corners name, Remember Pepper?, on 13 June 2008. Murray met Hughes by chance in 2009 at a train stop in London when the train was diverted to an alternate station.[1] Murray is originally from England and Hughes grew up in Arizona and Texas, then moved to England for a number of years to pursue a life in music.

spins.label: In the US on Epic Records
spins.publish_note: Hooverphonic is a Belgian band established in 1995. Although they were initially characterized as a trip-hop group, they quickly broadened their sound to the point that they could no longer be categorized in a single genre. The band's original name was Hoover, but they eventually changed it to Hooverphonic because other bands were already using the Hoover moniker, they also wanted to avoid any legal concerns with the popular vacuum cleaner company. Hooverphonic's lineup has consisted of bassist Alex Callier, guitarist Raymond Geerts, and a number of lead singers. Among them were Liesje Sadonius (1996-1997), Geike Arnaert (1997-2008, 2020-2025), Noémie Wolfs (2010-2015), and Luka Cruysberghs (2018–2020).

spins.label: Spotted Peccary Music (Portland)
spins.publish_note: An anchor musician during the early years of the Spotted Peccary label, Greg Klamt has become internationally known for his contemporary, neo-classical compositions of symphonic orchestration backed by driving electronic and percussive rhythms, and expansive atmospheric textures. Klamt masterfully interweaves symphonic, progressive electronic, and indigenous styles into a dynamic work of sonic artistry in this follow-up to his critically acclaimed debut release, Fulcrum. With ultra-high sound quality and a clear and vivid soundstage, Fluxus Quo is an excellent example of the driving electronics, percussive rhythms, and neoclassical orchestrations which help make Greg Klamt’s music some of the best of the New American sound.
